comment: The design of tools/ui-scripts/fill-cavity.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1818): a block 40 x 20 x 15 (Box1, F1, Body1) with a wall 20 x 20 x 5 on its right half (Box2, F2, joined), a blind slit along the wall's foot 2 x 10, 5 deep (Box3, F3: 100), a groove across the lower half open at both ends 10 wide, 3 deep (Box4, F4: 600; wide and shallow so that its floor shows in the view), and Plane1 (F5) 15 above XY, the lower half's top: 14000 - 100 - 600 = 13300.
